subject.title: feat(ios): harvest shared chat capabilities — verbosity, trace toggle, live talk level, sessions entry

question: Should iOS adopt the same persisted, default-on assistant trace preference as macOS, changing its prior always-hidden trace behavior?
rationale: The branch creates a new visible persisted setting and changes the default iOS presentation of assistant reasoning/tool activity; tests can verify wiring but cannot decide the intended user-facing preference contract.

options.title: Adopt macOS parity with proof
options.body: Confirm the default-on local trace preference for iOS and require redacted fresh-install/upgrade runtime proof before merge.

options.title: Keep traces hidden by default
options.body: Retain the current hidden-by-default iOS behavior and expose trace visibility only through a separately approved opt-in design.

recommendation.title: Adopt macOS parity with proof
recommendation.body: Confirm the default-on local trace preference for iOS and require redacted fresh-install/upgrade runtime proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the closely related merged native-chat parity implementation and can clarify the intended cross-client preference contract.
